paragraphs: Mentioned in [Avodah Zarah 27a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.27a.8), reporting in the name of Rav and disagreeing with Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman says that this is not the well-known Rav Papa, but the son of Rav Papa the Elder.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage has Daru bar Papa speak in Rav’s name and then gives Rabbi Yochanan’s different scriptural argument.
Hyman identifies Daru as a son of Rav Papa the Elder. The linked passage supplies only bar Papa.
